series.title: Storybooks
series.description: Illustrated storybooks that welcome children and families into Hawkins Hollow through gentle adventures, familiar feelings, and shared reading time.

editorial.welcomeText: If this is your first visit to Hawkins Hollow, this story is a gentle place to begin.
editorial.experienceText: Gentle illustrated adventures that introduce Hawkins Hollow one memory at a time.

series.title: First Readers
series.description: Simple, encouraging stories for children beginning to read with a helper.

editorial.welcomeText: These stories use simple language for children beginning to read with a helper.
editorial.audienceText: Beginning readers and the grown-ups reading beside them.
editorial.experienceText: Short, approachable stories with steady pacing and confidence-building repetition.

series.title: Second Readers
series.description: Longer stories for children growing in reading confidence and independence.

editorial.welcomeText: These stories offer richer detail and longer paths for growing readers.
editorial.audienceText: Readers ready for broader adventures and deeper story threads.
editorial.experienceText: More independent reading with warm support from familiar Hawkins Hollow friends.

series.title: Basic Training
series.description: Skill-building stories that help children practice habits, confidence, and everyday courage.

editorial.welcomeText: These stories support everyday skills through caring characters and practical moments.
editorial.audienceText: Families helping children practice everyday readiness and resilience.
editorial.experienceText: Guided stories for growth, confidence, and healthy routines.

series.title: Growing Together
series.description: Stories about belonging, cooperation, and family relationships that deepen over time.

editorial.welcomeText: These stories help families grow through kindness, listening, and shared effort.
editorial.audienceText: Families who want encouragement around belonging and cooperation.
editorial.experienceText: Heart-forward stories about care, patience, and growing together.

series.title: Bedtime Library
series.description: Quiet stories for winding down and ending the day with reassurance.

editorial.welcomeText: Slow down, settle in, and choose a story for the end of the day.
editorial.audienceText: Children and caregivers looking for gentle stories before rest.
editorial.experienceText: Calm pacing and reassuring endings for shared bedtime moments.

series.title: Tender Times
series.description: Comforting stories for moments when children need reassurance, connection, and care.

editorial.welcomeText: These stories were written for moments when children need reassurance, comfort, and connection.
editorial.audienceText: Families moving through change, big feelings, or difficult days.
editorial.experienceText: Comfort-centered stories that make room for healing and hope.

series.title: Holiday Story Poems
series.description: Seasonal poems and celebrations that mark special days in Hawkins Hollow.

editorial.welcomeText: Follow holidays and traditions through story poems written for shared reading.
editorial.audienceText: Families celebrating seasonal traditions and gatherings.
editorial.experienceText: Festive story poems that invite reflection, gratitude, and joy.

series.title: Hero Play Poems
series.description: Imaginative poems where children explore courage, play, and pretend adventures.

editorial.welcomeText: These poems celebrate imagination, bravery, and playful adventure.
editorial.audienceText: Children who love pretend play and imaginative storytelling.
editorial.experienceText: Rhythmic poems that inspire confidence and creative exploration.
